alert: IRCFiber public endpoint failing from outside

annotations.summary: https://ircfiber.com/health is not answering 200 from outside the host
annotations.description: Counts successful synthetic probes of the public endpoint. Below one success for the whole window means users cannot reach the site — the only rule here that sees what the operator saw on 2026-09-06 by loading the site in a browser. The probe must run OFF the prod host (the k3s collector on ubuntu-docker is a genuinely external vantage point) so it survives the host wedging. DISABLED BY DEFAULT: no httpcheck receiver is configured anywhere yet. Add it to site/deploy/k8s/signoz/values.yaml (snippet in README-alerts.md), then set signoz_alert_enable_endpoint_probe: true.
